purpose: Image-generated material reskins on existing craftable equipment geometry

originalRecord.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square base-color texture map for a 3D fantasy game's T30 dewglass metal armor, closely following the viewed icon references. Generate a flat orthographic evenly lit macro material sample filling the entire square. Layered deep teal mineral glass, luminous turquoise veins, small milky opalescent mint and pale cyan mineral flecks, delicate organic silver-white branching leaf veins sparsely crossing the surface, translucent-looking crystalline depth frozen into forged metal. Rich small-scale mottled mineral surface detail, irregular natural interlocking translucent shards. Color values predominantly medium teal with lighter accents, NO black areas. Flat albedo only, no cast shadows or directional highlights, no objects, no armor, no labels, no borders, no text. Seamless tileable edges. This map will be applied to real modeled leaf-shaped armor plates.
originalRecord.review: Author inspected full texture; layered turquoise crystalline mineral and silver veins follow reviewed dewglass references.

originalRecord.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: three-material texture atlas for fantasy 3D equipment. CENTER THIRD is rich blue-green mistweave cloth, fine visible woven thread structure, nuanced teal jade cyan thread colors and tiny pale silver embroidered leaf-vein motifs spaced far apart. originalRecord.review: Author inspected full atlas. Three clean material columns match pale willow, blue-green mistweave and dark leather. Crop interiors at module load.
